installBody: Prayer times, adhan notifications, qibla, duas, and the Quran, even when offline.
iosSteps: Tap the Share button in Safari, then choose "Add to Home Screen". Notifications only work after the app is added to the Home Screen.
androidSteps: Tap Install, or open the browser menu and choose "Add to Home screen".
offlineNow: You are offline. Showing saved content.

notifications.title: Adhan notifications
notifications.body: Get a notification at each prayer time and before iqamah.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. On iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first.

iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
iosStep2: Choose "Add to Home Screen", then tap Add.
